name: io.github.LuiggiVal08/toon-memory
description: Offline persistent memory for AI coding agents — 35 tools, 80% fewer calls, no LLM
title: Toon Memory

environmentVariables.name: TOON_MEMORY_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Encryption key for AES-256-GCM memory encryption

environmentVariables.name: TOON_MEMORY_CAPTURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable activity capture hooks

environmentVariables.name: TOON_MEMORY_BRANCH
environmentVariables.description: Override the auto-detected git branch name

environmentVariables.name: TOON_MEMORY_NO_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Set to disable session heartbeat tracking

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub personal access token for exporting/importing memory to Gist
